description: This file defines an abstract class `HTMLPurifier_TagTransform` that models mutations of obsolete HTML tags into valid tags during HTML purification. It includes properties and methods related to transforming tags and manipulating style attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TagTransform
classes.description: An abstract base class that specifies how to transform obsolete or invalid HTML tags into valid ones, including a method for prepending CSS styles to element attributes.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform a given tag into a valid tag, requiring implementation in subclasses.

methods.name: prependCSS
methods.description: Prepend CSS properties to the 'style' attribute of an attribute array, creating the attribute if it doesn't exist.
